svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Saw a 20 mm slice off 60 x 40 mm bar; saw and file it to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 wide x 33 deep x 20 tall. The flat back goes on the back plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scribe a 90 degree V on both 60 x 33 faces with a 45 degree square:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50.3 mm wide at the front face, point 7.8 mm from the back face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw just inside both lines, file to the lines, keep the V faces flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the V's sharp front edges 0.5 mm so they cannot score the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3.3 mm, 14 mm deep, and tap M4 12 deep in the back face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 18 mm each side of centre, half way up (10 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M4 countersunk screws from the front of the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 48.3 mm pole touches both V faces 24.9 mm from the plate,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 8 mm inside the front face. 40 to 60 mm poles also seat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a 48 mm tube the block must not rock; hold it to light,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: light should show at the bottom of the V, not along the faces.
